problem:
The equation below describes all the points on the line segment $\overset{―}{PQ},$ where $P(-3,5,0)$ and $Q(0,-3,2).$

$$
r(t)=[\begin{aligned}a \\ 5 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -8 \\ b\end{aligned}],\,t\in [c,1]
$$

What is the value of $a+b+c?$
worked_solution:
We need to find a direction vector that is parallel to the given line. We can use the vector $\overset{\to }{PQ}$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}v & =\overset{\to }{PQ} \\  & =\overset{\to }{OQ}-\overset{\to }{OP} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -3 \\ 2\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 5 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -8 \\ 2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, the vector equation of the line is

$$
r=p+tv\,⟹\,r=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 5 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -8 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$

and the vector equation of the  line segment $\overset{―}{PQ}$ is

$$
r(t)=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 5 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -8 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,t\in [0,1].
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=(-3)+2+0=-1.
$$
